claim: Three stages: (1) evolve a student-side harness h* and adapt it into a private reference harness K; (2) agent-as-harness trajectory collection; (3) SFT on the reviewed trajectories, deployed under h alone

claim: SFT on accepted responses in reviewed rollouts, both unchanged student proposals and harness-guided replacements; reviewer-perspective reasoning is masked from the loss
